description: Schedule facts stated in one X post, linked to current schedule rows.

items.description: One item per affected stream; empty when the post states neither a concrete fact about a current row nor a new stream inside the Current week.

row.description: 1-based number from Current schedule rows, or null for a stream with no matching row.

start.description: Start time the post states as 24-hour HH:MM, or null.

tz.description: Time zone the post gives for the time, as its usual abbreviation, or null.

text.description: For a matched row: what the post adds or changes about the stream beyond that row, copied exactly; empty when it only points at the stream or gives only a date, time, or status. For row null or a day-off row: everything the post says about the stream itself, copied exactly; empty when it says nothing about it.

evidence.description: Exact contiguous substring of the post that states the fact.
